title: Men's Chest Bag – Sling Bag for Sports & Leisure
descriptionHtml:
Keep the essentials close to your body

On the bike, the motorcycle or a hike you want your phone, keys and wallet easy to reach. With an ordinary backpack you have to keep taking it off to get to them.

Handy bag with many compartments

The chest bag sits firmly on your body and has several compartments for your things. The straps are adjustable so the bag sits comfortably whatever the activity.

Features

  • Several compartments for phone, keys and wallet
  • Adjustable straps for a good fit
  • Sits firmly during movement
  • Good for cycling, motorcycling and hiking
  • Durable material with zippers

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
